tool_args.rationale: The target horizon is far beyond the observed H≤0.48 window. The slow-horizon probe directly constrains the slow exponential and the predicted reversal.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-exponential model to pilot rows alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon observations do not identify the slow component reliably enough for extrapolation to H=24.3.
Additional fine-scale observations would not resolve the long-horizon reversal as directly.
The supplied mechanism note and pilot signatures favor endogenous dual-horizon adaptation; a long-horizon measurement can distinguish its reversal.
